title: Land Law Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any material in its native state which when extracted has economic value."
A natural resource is any material in its native state which when extracted has economic value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interest in land conveyed by a rightful possessor of real property for use and occupation of another in consideration for rent paid."
A leasehold interest is an interest in land conveyed by a rightful possessor of real property for use and occupation of another in consideration for rent paid.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an embodiment of express and implied covenants which regulates the rights and obligations of the parties."
A tenancy contract is an embodiment of express and implied covenants which regulates the rights and obligations of the parties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a right to enter the land of another person and take something off the land."
A profit a prendre is a right to enter the land of another person and take something off the land.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important agricultural resource."
Land is the most important agricultural resource.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the very essence of a legal mortgage."
Redemption is the very essence of a legal mortgage.
fib: ______ is the compensation paid to a landlord by a tenant for use and occupation of his premises.
Mesne profit is the compensation paid to a landlord by a tenant for use and occupation of his premises.
______ is a yielding up of an estate to the owner of the reversionary interest in the property.
Surrender is a yielding up of an estate to the owner of the reversionary interest in the property.
______ is any damage to premises or to land that tends to be permanent and lasting loss to the person entitled to the inheritance.
Waste is any damage to premises or to land that tends to be permanent and lasting loss to the person entitled to the inheritance.
______ is the hallmark of a fee simple.
General inheritability is the hallmark of a fee simple.
______ refers to more than one person having an interest in a particular land.
Co- ownership of land refers to more than one person having an interest in a particular land.
______ is regarded in law as analogous to joint tenancy arrangement.
property is regarded in law as analogous to joint tenancy arrangement.
